theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α lam Lam K : ℝ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (W : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < α → α < 1 → 0 < lam → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ A P P) → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |A P Q| ≤ Lam * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → ContDiff ℝ 1 W → (∀ x y : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ W x - fderiv ℝ W y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ W x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ∀ x y : Rn n, fderiv ℝ W x = fderiv ℝ W y
